title: Unable to sign in
description: Customer receives an error when trying to sign in after resetting the password.

title: Payment not reflected
description: An incoming payment has not appeared in the account balance.

title: Update contact details
description: Customer wants to update the registered telephone number.

title: Duplicate transaction
description: Customer has reported two identical transactions on the same day.

title: Account statement missing
description: Monthly statement is not visible in the portal.

title: Address change request
description: Customer submitted a new postal address and wants confirmation.

title: Transfer declined
description: Transfer was declined without a clear reason shown in the UI.

title: Notifications not arriving
description: Push notifications stopped arriving on a registered device.

title: Incorrect account nickname
description: Nickname shown on the dashboard differs from the saved value.

title: Refund status unclear
description: Customer needs an update on a pending merchant refund.

title: Card blocked unexpectedly
description: Card has been blocked after a verified purchase.

title: Standing order change
description: Customer requested a change to a recurring standing order.
